mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of RSAFS and HOUST both above 200-day moving averages fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) increase risk aversion and reduce liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic growth, supporting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO is above 200-day moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 3.5% (CPIAUCSL) triggers central bank hawkishness and real rate increases, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in employment (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units (HOUST) during late-cycle expansion signals weakening consumer demand and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1300 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
